title: The Chip in the Blue Tile
youtube_title: The Chip in the Blue Tile | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Bibi is tangled up with a chip in a blue tile from a dropped ladle and almost hides it. Bibi tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
